english: Storey / top floor / attic / furnished loft
keywords: Storey / top floor / attic / furnished loft tabulātum, tabulātī n.; subtēgulāneum, -ī n.  tabulātum, tabulātī n.  — storey / floor of a building; also boarded flooring;  етаж; също дъсчен под . Traupman p. 125; ancient storey sense in Lewis & Short.  summum tabulātum  — top floor;  последен етаж . A natural compositional expression, suitable for the habitable top floor beneath the roof.  subtēgulāneum, subtēgulāneī n.  — attic / loft room;  таван / таванско помещение . Traupman p. 122; Morgan–Owens lists it under furnished attic. An older Morgan draft warns that the related adjective in Pliny has uncertain meaning; the modern lexicographic use is firmer than a claim of an exact classical attic term.  conclāve sub tēctō  — room under the roof / loft room;  стая под покрива / обитаема таванска стая . Our transparent alternative. The space need not be used for storage.  Eāmus sūrsum!  — Let’s go upstairs!  Да се качим горе!   Ascendāmus in summum tabulātum.  — Let’s go up to the top floor.  Да се качим на последния етаж.
